run_wine_quality_models_experiment: run the wine quality models experiment with mlp architecture and learning rate 0.1
run_wine_quality_conformal_training: run the wine quality conformal training sub experiment with threshold logp method
run_wine_quality_importance_sweep: run the wine quality importance 0 or 1 sub experiment with loss matrix parameter sweep
run_wine_quality_confusion_sweep: run the wine quality confusion 1_0 or 0_1 sub experiment with confusion loss matrix sweep
get_parameters_config: get the wine quality experiment configuration and parameter sweep for a given experiment and sub experiment
